ATTACK_RANSOMWARE: Isolate infected hosts immediately by disconnecting network cables and revoking Wi-Fi access.
Do NOT reboot or power down the machine if volatile RAM forensics are required.
Verify volume shadow copy integrity on uninfected network domain controllers.
Block identified C2 IP addresses and file hashes at the perimeter firewall/EDR.
Initiate system restore from offline, air-gapped backup infrastructure.
ATTACK_CREDENTIAL_HARVESTING: Force immediate password reset and invalidate all active session tokens for affected accounts.
Enforce FIDO2 / Hardware MFA keys across external access gateways.
Implement rate-limiting and IP throttling on public authentication endpoints.
Inspect authentication logs for successful logins originating from suspicious IPs during the event timeframe.
ATTACK_PHISHING_COMPROMISE: Purge malicious phishing email message IDs from all organizational mailboxes via API.
Reset credentials for any user who clicked the link or submitted web forms.
Add malicious domain names and URL parameters to perimeter DNS sinkhole filters.
Conduct immediate security awareness triage for affected operational units.
ATTACK_C2_EXFILTRATION: Block outbound communication to destination C2 IP addresses/domains across perimeter firewalls.
Isolate compromised host and perform full RAM and network socket capture.
Revoke service accounts associated with the compromised process tree.
Inspect proxy logs to quantify total volume of exfiltrated data payload.
ATTACK_SQL_INJECTION: Apply Web Application Firewall (WAF) rules blocking SQL syntax parameters immediately.
Sanitize all web input vectors using parameterized queries and prepared statements.
Audit database access logs to check if confidential tables were queried or altered.
Apply principle of least privilege to web database service user accounts.
ATTACK_PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION: Enable Credential Guard on Windows endpoints to protect LSASS process memory.
Rotate credentials for all Domain Admin and Enterprise Admin accounts immediately.
Inspect Active Directory logs for unauthorized account creations or group privilege modifications.
Terminate unauthorized active administrative sessions across enterprise hosts.
ATTACK_CRYPTOMINING: Identify and kill unauthorized miner process IDs via EDR/Host management tools.
Inspect task scheduler and cron jobs for persistent installation scripts.
Block cryptocurrency mining pool domain names and stratum ports at perimeter.
Review software deployment logs to identify how binary was introduced.
ATTACK_INSIDER_EXFIL: Suspend user account privileges and revoke VPN / cloud application access.
Place legal hold on employee computer workstation, email mailbox, and cloud storage.
Audit Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) logs for all access history over past 90 days.
Notify corporate legal, HR, and compliance leadership.
